bug.description: Anyone who can see an order can share it: `share` checks `canViewOrder(owner, order)` instead of checking that the caller is the order's customer, so a user it was shared with (or staff) can share it further. The spec says only the order's customer can share it.

decoy.description: Sharing an order with yourself silently does nothing (returns the order, no error, no entry added). The spec asks for exactly this, because the share box may include the owner.
